theory.title: Describe la personalidad y expresa emociones
theory.explanation: Para describir cómo es o cómo se siente alguien usamos el verbo to be + adjetivo: I am friendly, she is shy, they are happy. El adjetivo no cambia en plural. Para negar usamos not: he isn't angry, they aren't sad. Para preguntar, colocamos am, is o are delante del sujeto: Are you tired? Is she worried? Podemos usar very para intensificar y a little para expresar un grado pequeño. Añade because para explicar una razón. En conversación puedes usar contracciones: I'm = I am, she's = she is y they're = they are.
theory.tip: Usa am con I, is con he/she/it y are con you/we/they. Los adjetivos no llevan plural: one friendly person, two friendly people. Happy y worried describen estados; friendly y shy describen rasgos de personalidad.

patterns.label: Give a short answer
patterns.pattern: Yes, subject + am / is / are. No, subject + am not / isn't / aren't.

patterns.label: Give a reason
examples: Mia is excited because it is her birthday.
